## Description

Komatsu loader intake air filter cross-referenced under OE number 42N-62-15470, listed in the heavy-machinery engine-intake category. dimensions, media and efficiency are reference values only. For loaders working high-dust off-highway duty, buyers should prioritise confirmed dust-holding capacity and intake-restriction control over a nominal efficiency label. Before committing a bulk line, verify the form factor, pleat construction and ISO 5011 capacity against the OE drawing and request the spec sheet rather than relying on the catalogue alone.
